blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At fixed 2026-07-15 blocks Ethereum 25534997, Base 48646186, Worldchain 32373046, BSC 110049753, Polygon 90251163, and Gnosis 47208124, every tracked WMXN proxy resolved to 0x425abec6165c83d30fcf81ec66635c6c7ee2bbf7 and returned paused() = false. On each route, 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b held both PAUSER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. Ethereum, Base, and Worldchain run the verified pausable LatamStable variant, so that EOA can halt all ERC-20 updates; BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis run the verified compliance variant, which additionally exposes blockUser, unblockUser, and setEnforceBlocklist and rejects a blocked sender or receiver in _update when enforcement is enabled. This is an asset-wide direct freeze conclusion from all six tracked routes, but address-specific blocklisting is only asserted for BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. The V9 transfer review is resolved by the direct pause/blocklist mechanisms, not a permissioning-adapter inference. Ripio's public GitHub organization did not expose a wFIAT/LatamStable Solidity repository, and Archive.org returned no snapshot for the reviewed English wFIAT page; deployed explorer source and fixed RPC evidence remain sufficient. The issuer's March 2026 collateral certification was reviewed as transparency evidence, not as access-control proof.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WMXN has six independent native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis; their issuer-direct native minting and UUPS upgrade paths remain in Mint Authority. Ripio's LimitedMinterBridge and BridgeDeposit form an issuer-operated burn/mint transfer rail with route-scoped bridge mint, rate-limit, pause, admin, operator, and replay/accounting controls. Celo is a probable bridge representation: its current role graph grants bridge-style minter contracts but its source-chain burn and destination fulfillment binding remain unresolved. No third-party bridge was identified.

routes.protocol: Ripio native wMXN (wFIAT issuer burn-mint bridge)
routes.reviewNote: Verified on-chain 2026-07-20 (block 25570752): native issuer-minted WMXN; MINTER_ROLE held by issuer EOA 0x466c02e2, LimitedMinter 0xD168CFbBE260D48cd119497a9a2eE8482080C5E7 (fixed-destination on-ramp minter) and LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cB034feC6ceC46CaeD4f61281f5Aa0Eb0e6 (hasRole reads). Cross-chain movement uses Ripio's own verified bridge contract 0x465e642387d3d73a57cdc1368ffa53a800ba5d47 (depositForBridge burns via burnFrom; fulfillBridgeMint, gated by BRIDGE_OPERATOR_ROLE held by Ripio ops EOAs 0x5ca3f8ee and 0xbc924f70, calls LimitedMinterBridge.mintTo). LimitedMinterBridge has WMXN registered with a 100,000/day mint cap, is unpaused, and is administered by EOA 0x466c02e2 plus the Ripio 4/7 Safe 0x2b839174 (getThreshold/getOwners re-verified). No third-party bridge holds mint rights.
